title: Topic 6.1: Obligations of Parents to Children

pages.lesson:
LESSON: OBLIGATIONS OF PARENTS TO CHILDREN

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Muamalaat (Social Relations)
Topic 6.1: Obligations of Parents to Children

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Obligations of Parents to Children. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Obligations of Parents to Children
2. Practise Obligations of Parents to Children at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Obligations of Parents to Children

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Obligations of Parents to Children
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Obligations of Parents to Children. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Obligations of Parents to Children at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Obligations of Parents to Children at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Obligations of Parents to Children
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Obligations of Parents to Children. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Obligations of Parents to Children using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Obligations of Parents to Children in the examples.
2. Explain Obligations of Parents to Children to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Obligations of Parents to Children.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Obligations of Parents to Children using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Obligations of Parents to Children important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Obligations of Parents to Children
2. Practise Obligations of Parents to Children at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Obligations of Parents to Children

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
